Equate the curve and straight line equations:
$$3x^2 - 4x + 4 = mx + m - 1 \implies 3x^2 - (m + 4)x + (5 - m) = 0$$

Set the discriminant $\Delta > 0$ for two distinct points of intersection:
$$\Delta = [-(m + 4)]^2 - 4(3)(5 - m) > 0$$
$$(m^2 + 8m + 16) - 12(5 - m) > 0 \implies m^2 + 8m + 16 - 60 + 12m > 0$$
$$m^2 + 20m - 44 > 0$$

State the outside solution intervals:
$$m < -22 \quad \text{or} \quad m > 2$$
